```{r}
#| label: setup-triangulation
#| include: false
root <- Sys.getenv("TRI_REPO_ROOT")
run_dir <- Sys.getenv("TRI_RUN_DIR")
output <- Sys.getenv("TRI_OUTPUT_DIR")
if (!nzchar(root) || !dir.exists(run_dir) || !dir.exists(output)) stop("Use a dedicated Make target with an explicit saved RUN.")
source(file.path(root, "R", "bmi_hypercapnia_triangulation.R"))
source(file.path(root, "R", "triangulation_reporting.R"))
require_tri_packages(c("ggplot2", "jsonlite", "digest", "knitr"))
bundle <- read_tri_bundle(run_dir)
if (bundle$manifest$schema_version != 2L) stop("Version-1 results use the frozen historical report.")
analysis <- bundle$analysis
results <- analysis$results
artificial <- bundle$manifest$mode == "fixture"
figures <- tri_figure_candidates(results, artificial)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(dev = if (knitr::is_latex_output()) "cairo_pdf" else "png")
frame_label <- function(x) unname(c(severe_obesity = "BMI ≥40", abg_drawn = "ABG obtained", any_gas_drawn = "Either gas obtained")[x])
outcome_label <- function(x) unname(c(icd = "ICD", abg = "ABG", any_gas = "Either gas")[x])
window_label <- function(x) ifelse(x == "encounter", "Encounter", "Index day")
table_out <- function(x, caption) knitr::kable(x, caption = caption, booktabs = TRUE, row.names = FALSE)
identity_columns <- function(r) data.frame(Frame = frame_label(r$frame), Outcome = outcome_label(r$outcome), Window = window_label(r$ascertainment_window))
```

```{r}
#| label: status-banner
#| results: asis
cat(if (artificial) "**ARTIFICIAL DATA — every numerical result is simulated for workflow and layout verification.**\n\n" else "**DRAFT CLINICAL RESULTS — source declarations and identity checks passed; scientific and release review remain separate.**\n\n")
if (any(results$source_status == "pending")) cat("**Calendar-day sensitivity source evidence is pending. Its six positions have no estimates or measured model counts.**\n\n")
```

# Question and approved specification

How does modeled documented hypercapnia frequency change under a **one-unit BMI reduction for patients with observed BMI >30 kg/m²**? For every model-evaluable patient, use $BMI^*=BMI-1$ when $BMI>30$ and $BMI^*=BMI$ otherwise. There is no floor at 30: 30.2 becomes 29.2, 40 becomes 39, and 30 remains unchanged. Eligibility for the shift uses observed BMI.

The primary quantity is the model-standardized potential impact fraction (PIF), $1-\bar p_{\mathrm{shifted}}/\bar p_{\mathrm{observed}}$. Both probabilities average predictions over the same cell-specific complete cases. Original frame membership, selected encounter and adjustment values stay fixed. We also report the absolute probability difference and the percentage eligible for the shift.

This is a common BMI-shift scenario applied to deliberately different estimands. It is not a constant fraction attributable to each BMI unit. Its value depends on the BMI distribution, proportion shifted and modeled outcome probability. The supporting BMI odds ratio describes a different quantity.

The population is adults aged ≥18 with emergency or inpatient encounters starting in **2022**, within the authenticated captured source. Each patient contributes their first qualifying encounter independently within each frame, selected before checking outcome or covariate completeness:

| Frame | Membership |
|:--|:--|
| Severe obesity | Observed BMI ≥40 kg/m² |
| ABG obtained | Confirmed arterial testing, without a BMI threshold |
| Either gas obtained | Confirmed arterial or venous testing, without a BMI threshold |

A patient may have different index encounters across frames. The legacy derived BMI is retained. Adjustment uses linear BMI and age, sex, combined race/ethnicity and region (the source field `location`).

{{< pagebreak >}}

# Outcomes, windows and evidence

| Outcome | Definition | Ascertainment |
|:--|:--|:--|
| ICD | J96.02, J96.12, J96.22, J96.92 or E66.2 | Encounter; primary |
| ABG | Arterial PaCO~2~ ≥45 mm Hg | Encounter; primary |
| Either gas | Arterial PaCO~2~ ≥45 or venous PCO~2~ ≥50 mm Hg | Encounter; primary |
| ABG | The same arterial threshold | Index calendar day; sensitivity |
| Either gas | The same combined thresholds | Index calendar day; sensitivity |

Applying these five specifications within each frame yields **nine primary and six sensitivity cells**. ICD is not duplicated for the gas timing sensitivity. No pH or ventilatory-support criterion is required. E66.2 is retained and acknowledged as an obesity-containing diagnosis.

Index calendar day means the collection date equals the encounter-start date under the authenticated source date convention. It does not mean elapsed 24 hours. Frame membership and index selection remain fixed. A later-only gas cannot establish a calendar-day positive or negative result.

Any valid positive gas establishes combined positivity. At least one valid gas with every available result below its threshold establishes an **available-gas negative**. With no valid result, the outcome is unknown. An unmeasured specimen is not a negative measurement. Testing evidence and result availability are separate. Discordant calendar-day summaries remain unknown and cannot change a primary index.

Source-pending sensitivity cells differ from patient-level unknown outcomes. Qualified primary analyses may proceed while timing evidence is pending; failed models retain their positions and explicit reasons.

# Cohort and index audit

```{r}
#| label: scope-counts
s <- analysis$scope
table_out(data.frame(Step = c("Input rows", "Duplicate primary-field rows collapsed", "Distinct primary encounter versions", "Keys with conflicting primary versions", "In study scope", "Outside scope", "Uncertain scope"), N = tri_count(unlist(s, use.names = FALSE))), "Source-scope accounting. Calendar-day disagreement does not create a primary-field conflict.")
```

```{r}
#| label: frame-counts
f <- analysis$frame_counts
table_out(data.frame(Frame = frame_label(f$frame), Confirmed = tri_count(f$n_frame_patients), Resolved = tri_count(f$n_index_resolved), Unresolved = tri_count(f$n_index_unresolved), `Uncertain membership only` = tri_count(f$n_membership_uncertain), check.names = FALSE), "Patients within each frame. Overlapping frames must not be summed.")
```

Conflicting primary versions, earliest-date ties and potentially earlier qualifying encounters remain unresolved. No later encounter is substituted for a more complete outcome or covariate profile. Confirmed patients remain in the frame audit even when their index is unresolved.

# Cell-specific denominator accounting

```{r}
#| label: denominator-accounting
coverage <- cbind(identity_columns(results), Indexed = tri_count(results$n_index_resolved), Known = tri_count(results$n_outcome_known), Unknown = tri_count(results$n_outcome_missing), Model = tri_count(results$n_model), Events = tri_count(results$n_events))
table_out(coverage, "Indexed = known + unknown; known = model cases + missing covariates, when the source module is qualified. Dashes indicate unassessed counts.")
```

```{r}
#| label: exclusion-and-support
support <- cbind(identity_columns(results), `Missing covariates` = tri_count(results$n_missing_adjustment), `Shifted, n` = tri_count(results$n_bmi_shifted), `Shifted, %` = ifelse(is.na(results$pct_bmi_shifted), "—", sprintf("%.1f", results$pct_bmi_shifted)), `Outside BMI range, n` = tri_count(results$n_counterfactual_outside_support), `Day conflicts, n` = tri_count(results$n_index_day_conflicts))
table_out(support, "Eligibility and marginal BMI support. Shifted percentages use model N; calendar-day conflicts are unavailable evidence, not negative outcomes.")
```

Complete cases require the selected outcome, BMI, age, sex, race/ethnicity and region. A confirmed draw without a usable result stays in its frame but can leave the outcome unknown. Each fraction describes its model-evaluable population; it does not automatically generalize to everyone eligible for the nominal frame.

Patients with BMI ≤30 stay in both prediction averages. In the severe-obesity frame all model cases shift, including BMI 40 to 39. Some shifted values can fall below that cell's observed fitted BMI range. This marginal check does not establish covariate-specific support when zero.

# Standardized probabilities, fractions and supporting associations

```{r}
#| label: standardized-probabilities
probabilities <- cbind(identity_columns(results), `Observed, %` = tri_percent(results$p_observed), `Shifted, %` = tri_percent(results$p_counterfactual), `Difference, pp` = tri_percent(results$absolute_difference, 3))
table_out(probabilities, "Paired mean predicted probabilities; pp = percentage points. Both predictions use the same patients.")
```

```{r}
#| label: impact-estimates
display <- prepare_tri_display(results)$data
table_out(cbind(identity_columns(results), `PIF (95% CI)` = display$estimate_label, N = tri_count(results$n_model)), "Model-standardized one-unit-shift PIFs. Tiny nonzero estimates retain visible precision; genuine zero remains zero.")
```

```{r}
#| label: supporting-associations
or_label <- ifelse(results$status == "estimated", sprintf("%.3f (%.3f–%.3f)", results$odds_ratio, results$conf_low, results$conf_high), ifelse(results$source_status == "pending", "Source pending", "Not estimable"))
table_out(cbind(identity_columns(results), `BMI OR (95% CI)` = or_label), "Supporting adjusted odds ratio per 1 kg/m² higher BMI; no OR-to-PIF conversion is used.")
```

# Estimation checks and timing transitions

Each model uses the unchanged formula:

```r
outcome ~ bmi + age_at_encounter +
  factor(sex) + factor(race_ethnicity) + factor(location)
```

The workflow checks outcome/BMI variation, rank, complete/quasi-complete separation, convergence, warnings and finite quantities. Nonestimable cells retain a reason. No alternative estimator or adjustment term is substituted.

PIF intervals use the full coefficient covariance for the delta method on the log ratio of mean predicted probabilities. They are pointwise, model-based 95% intervals conditional on the empirical covariates. Negative fractions remain visible. When no model case has BMI >30, the scenario is unchanged and its fraction and interval are exactly zero.

```{r}
#| label: estimation-status
#| results: asis
failed <- results[results$impact_status != "estimated", ]
if (nrow(failed)) print(table_out(cbind(identity_columns(failed), Reason = failed$impact_reason), "Pending and nonestimable cells.")) else cat("All fifteen artificial or clinical cells passed the implemented computational checks. This does not establish scientific acceptance.\n")
```

```{r}
#| label: timing-transitions
t <- analysis$timing_audit
if (any(results$source_status == "pending")) {
  table_out(data.frame(Frame = frame_label(t$frame), Outcome = outcome_label(t$outcome), Status = "Source pending"), "Timing comparisons remain unassessed.")
} else {
  groups <- split(seq_len(nrow(t)), paste(t$frame, t$outcome, sep = "/"))
  summary <- do.call(rbind, lapply(groups, function(rows) {
    z <- t[rows, ]
    data.frame(Frame = frame_label(z$frame[1]), Outcome = outcome_label(z$outcome[1]),
      `Positive to negative` = sum(z$n[z$primary_state == "positive" & z$index_day_state == "available_negative"]),
      `Known to unknown` = sum(z$n[z$primary_state != "unknown" & z$index_day_state == "unknown"]),
      `Unknown both` = sum(z$n[z$primary_state == "unknown" & z$index_day_state == "unknown"]), check.names = FALSE)
  }))
  table_out(summary, "Selected encounter-to-calendar-day transitions. The complete nine-state cross-tables are in timing_audit.csv.")
}
```

Calendar-day analyses can change both classification and the model-evaluable sample. The transition counts and denominator tables distinguish those changes. No additional same-sample models or formal between-cell comparisons are fitted.

```{r}
#| fig-alt: "Fifteen small panels compare observed bin frequencies with mean fitted probabilities across BMI, grouped by sampling frame and outcome/window. A vertical line marks BMI 40."
d <- analysis$bmi_diagnostics
if (nrow(d)) {
  d$panel <- factor(analysis$registry$display_order[match(d$cell_id, analysis$registry$cell_id)] %% 5,
    levels = c(1, 2, 3, 4, 0), labels = c("ICD\nEncounter", "ABG\nEncounter", "ABG\nIndex day", "Either gas\nEncounter", "Either gas\nIndex day"))
  d$frame <- factor(frame_label(analysis$registry$frame[match(d$cell_id, analysis$registry$cell_id)]), levels = frame_label(names(triangulation_frames)))
  long <- rbind(transform(d, series = "Observed frequency", probability = observed_fraction), transform(d, series = "Mean model prediction", probability = mean_fitted))
  p <- ggplot2::ggplot(long, ggplot2::aes(x = bin_low + 2.5, y = probability, shape = series, linetype = series)) +
    ggplot2::geom_vline(xintercept = 40, colour = "grey60", linewidth = .35) +
    ggplot2::geom_line(colour = "#184F64", linewidth = .4) + ggplot2::geom_point(colour = "#184F64", size = 1.6) +
    ggplot2::facet_grid(frame ~ panel, drop = FALSE) +
    ggplot2::scale_shape_manual(values = c("Observed frequency" = 1, "Mean model prediction" = 16)) +
    ggplot2::scale_linetype_manual(values = c("Observed frequency" = "dashed", "Mean model prediction" = "solid")) +
    ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(30, 40, 50, 60)) +
    ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), breaks = c(0, .5, 1)) +
    ggplot2::labs(x = "BMI (kg/m²); fixed bin midpoints", y = "Outcome frequency / probability", shape = NULL, linetype = NULL) +
    ggplot2::theme_minimal(base_family = "Arial", base_size = 10) +
    ggplot2::theme(legend.position = "bottom", strip.text = ggplot2::element_text(size = 9), axis.text = ggplot2::element_text(size = 9), panel.grid.minor = ggplot2::element_blank())
  print(p)
}
```

# Interpretation and reproducibility

Compare the explicitly different frame/outcome/window estimands using their magnitudes, intervals and denominators. Patients overlap and indexes can differ. No pooling, significance vote count, joint specification-curve test or independent-replication claim is made.

The shared one-unit shift does not equalize populations or remove testing selection, reverse causation, residual confounding or missingness assumptions. Each estimate depends on its fitted BMI distribution. The demographic adjustment set and linear functional form do not establish exchangeability. Gas outcomes describe physiologic measurements; ICD ascertainment includes E66.2. Incidence reduction and causal prevention are not established.

Estimation runs once. Version-2 bundles persist the scenario, fifteen-cell registry, full-precision results, aggregate diagnostics and input/source hashes. All report and figure revisions read the saved aggregates without reopening clinical data or refitting. Version-1 BMI-to-40 bundles are rendered only by their frozen historical sources and retain their original labels.

Only aggregate results are exported; indexes and identifiers remain in memory. Local artifacts are ignored by Git. Current upstream acceptance is reused within its documented scope; each input still needs an authenticated study mapping. The saved source assessment records which checks passed and which could not run. Archived R and Stata analyses retain their historical specifications and are available through explicit historical commands.
